summary: Iteration 15 focused on the plain-text signature bug (glued signature in text/plain emails). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter15.py (11 tests: improved html_to_text via /api/templates/preview, HTML-template path keeps HTML signature, per-account signature_text PUT/GET persistence, preview fallback, 7 converter edge cases) and /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_worker.py (3 worker-level tests patching send_email to inspect the real MIME bodies). All 14 new tests pass; full regression suite = 206 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend: verified login, /configuracoes -> Contas de Email -> edit-smtp-<id> dialog contains signature-text-input and generate-signature-text; the generate button produced 5 clean lines (Nome / Cargo / Phone / Email / Website) with no HTML tags, saving via save-smtp-button persisted and reloaded correctly; template Preview for a plain-text template renders the account signature_text with one info per line (no gluing). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: For templates with visible HTML content, the returned content_text does NOT include the plain-text signature, while worker._send_job/_send_sequence_step DO append signature_text to the text/plain alternative part. Preview-only inconsistency (cosmetic), send path is correct.

issues: Console a11y warning on open: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}' (appears for several dialogs, pre-existing Radix warning, not a new regression)

action_items: Optional: append the plain-text signature to content_text in /api/templates/preview for HTML templates so preview matches the multipart text part actually sent
Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings
critical_code_review_comments:
html_to_text now treats

,,,,,,,,,,
as newlines, strips script/style/head, decodes entities and collapses blank lines - verified: no glued output for table/div/li/br-less signatures.

worker._send_job and _send_sequence_step both prefer smtp.signature_text (with variable substitution) and fall back to html_to_text(signature_html); plain-text-only templates send no HTML part (verified html_body == '' via patched send_email), HTML templates keep the untouched HTML signature (compose_email_html) plus a clean text alternative -> both required formats present.
Frontend htmlToPlainSig mirrors the backend converter (same block-tag list + textContent decoding), so the 'Gerar a partir do HTML' output matches what the server would derive.

Default SMTP account signature_text/signature_html were saved and restored; current default account signature_text = clean 5-line Carlos Santo signature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature text/plain feature is fully working (backend converter, per-account signature_text, preview, worker). Reusable tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter15.py (API) and test_iter15_worker.py (patches worker.send_email to assert actual MIME text/html bodies - useful pattern since preview SMTP is fictitious). rca_of_the_issue: Original bug came from a naive tag-strip conversion that removed block tags without inserting newlines, so a table/div-based signature collapsed into a single line. Fix (html_to_text rewrite + per-account signature_text with client/server generators) verified end to end.
